parameters_convention: fraction, jaw distance in metres, roll, tilt Y, tilt Z, scale, arc angle; constant tool-local shape

source_observations.purpose: Fit one constant initial grip during the first closed-jaw interval; preserve heldout source frames and do not infer occluded sharp endpoints.
source_observations.pixel_convention: Native zero-based pixel xy; image_size per row.
source_observations.decoded_frame_hash_convention: SHA256 of C-contiguous uint8 OpenCV BGR native decoded frame bytes, no crop, resize or overlay.

endpoint_semantics.meaning: Sharp tapered CAD endpoint; endpoint0 is blunt. Proximal samples lie on the blunt/thread side of the grip.

split_protocol.reservation_note: Preserve original automatic frame roles. Reserved33/76 remain development holdouts, not a blind dataset.147 remains reserved in the original full-episode evidence but is not used here.

source_observations.review_protocol: Native source stereo and wrist frames5,33,47,76,104, enlarged crops and pixel grids; visible metallic segments inspected separately from braided thread. Terminal contrast inspected only in raw source pixels to locate the end of the fine highlight.

limitations: Polylines are independent image curve samples, not pointwise stereo or temporal material correspondences.
No line through a thread/clamp/head occlusion is an observed needle segment.
surface_contact:false means no surface equality is imposed, not proof of a positive metric gap.
Sparse visible evidence and CAD shape uncertainty do not establish an accepted camera or needle calibration.
Own PSM1 sharp tips are omitted; visible lower U-shaped branch is sampled only where separated from the head.
Only initial pre-indentation samples are included; no later tissue-entry highlight is used as a sharp endpoint.
source_observations.final_review: Source-only annotated preview checked before fitting. Stereo curves retain clearly visible bright free-needle segments; own PSM1 keeps metal on both sides of the clamp while excluding the blue braid, its junction, and occluded sharp tip.

limitations: This is a conditional estimated needle pose and circular curvature, not a measured needle SKU or accepted full scene calibration.
The optimization reached its 180-evaluation budget; numerical image checks passed, but metric calibration convergence was not established.
Frames 33 and 76 are development holdouts: their source needle observations were excluded from optimization, but they were reviewed during development.

Native stereo review at frames 138–140 shows the needle near the source needle, with visibly thicker CAD geometry and an endpoint mismatch of approximately 10 pixels; this is not exact silhouette agreement.

The actual sharp CAD endpoint lies behind the raised pad surface at frames 138–140 by up to 0.077 mm along the stereo rays. This is retained as a visibility limitation, not described as subpixel merely from its depth.
Raised region 1 permits penetration. Only the flat rectangular backing has an environment collider; the needle remains at least 5.602 mm clear of that backing over the declared replay.
The source-defined phase holds the needle continuously with PSM1; this clip does not test later releases or repeated regrasp events.
Full scene alignment remains unaccepted: camera/tool silhouettes and pad boundaries retain visible differences, including worsened PSM2 incision and PSM1 opposite-cap residuals.
acceptance_scope: Needle source-pixel numerical gates, supported initial jaw anchor, replay dynamics and rectangular-backing clearance for source frames 5–141 only.
